title: object-history: Task/TaskList history from Mark's Tasks draft registrations, drop the pending list (decision 23)
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H24. Crates: jmap-object-history-types, jmap-types (registry). Size: S.

Decision 23 (replaces the closed upstream ask H21, JMAP-tna1.3.23): Task and TaskList history registrations come from Mark's own updated Tasks draft (JMAP-jkl8.9), which registers JMAP Data Types for TaskList, Task and TaskNotification with Supports History Yes, Yes, No. Design: docs/design/object-history.md §2 (7.2 row), §4 (PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION), §9 tasks bullet.

Once that draft exists with its registrations:
- Add the TaskList, Task and TaskNotification rows to the jmap-types data-type registry (blobext:B1, JMAP-tna1.4), with Can Reference Blobs, Can Use for State Change and Supports History copied from the draft, and `reference` citing it by name.
- Remove Task and TaskList from OHT PENDING_HISTORY_REGISTRATION (H1, JMAP-tna1.3.1); remove the constant if it is then empty, or leave it empty with its rustdoc, whichever keeps the public API non-breaking.
- Update the rustdoc and object-history README that cite the pending list.

Acceptance:
- is_history_type is true for Task and TaskList through the registry, false for TaskNotification.
- The registry oracle test gains the three hand-copied rows.
- Each type crate's HistoryObject cross-check test still passes.
- CHANGELOG bullet; public-api snapshots.
notes: 2026-11-13: filed for decision 23; replaces the acceptance follow-up of the closed H21 (JMAP-tna1.3.23).
